newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends down vs basket, up vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends down vs basket, up vs dlr.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed firmer against the dollar but weaker versus the central bank's currency basket on Wednesday.
The forint finished the day at 182.40/45 to the dollar, compared to 182.56/61 in the morning and 182.47/52 at midday.
The Hungarian currency widened its gap from the central bank's resistance level (NBH bid) to around 50 fillers by the end of the session from some 30 pips at opening and about 40 at midday.
Dealers said the forint moved away from the NBH bid in the past two weeks amid some uncertainty of foreign investors due to the Czech central bank's fight for stabilising the crown.
But they said they did not expect the forint drift away substantially from the NBH bid.
The forint floats within the central bank's 4.5 percent wide intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
